not_decision_evidence: CALIBRATION ONLY. These numbers validate the INSTRUMENT and are not evidence about either engine. They cannot choose a threshold, a budget, a repetition count or a comparison statistic; those are D7's, frozen before the decisive run. No decisive workload was timed or resource-sampled to produce this file.

harness.repetitions_note: a CALIBRATION parameter for sizing the instrument, not the decisive N. The decisive N and its escalation ladder are preregistered by D7.

identity.gate_reason: no D7 attestation on disk: the freeze has not happened, so the gate is dormant by design and every decisive measurement is refused

regimes.process-cold: a fresh process every iteration, no in-process warmup. The default: cheap, portable, and honestly named.
regimes.warm: steady state after 2 DISCARDED iterations of the same cell. The process is still fresh each time; what is warm is the OS and filesystem cache.
regimes.machine-cold: NOT CLAIMED here. It exists only behind a documented reset protocol (cache drop / reboot / fresh VM), and 'caches not pre-warmed' with no reset step means a different kind of cold on Windows than on Linux. A machine-cold claim without its reset protocol is inadmissible, so this instrument does not make one.

phases.process-startup-core: user-visible? no — the child engine's own startup
phases.process-startup-launcher: user-visible: what a caller waits for before anything happens
phases.ownir-parse: the ownir document read and validate
phases.frontend-extraction: C# -> facts; recorded, NOT D7-gated unless separately ratified

rungs.why: A usage error: the process starts, reads argv, refuses, exits. No file is opened and no analysis runs, so this interval IS core startup rather than containing it.

A document the strict door refuses on its version. The read and parse happen; bridge and analysis never do. Subtracting core-usage leaves parse — a DERIVED view, labelled as such, never presented as a direct measurement.

The whole core path to the default surface. bridge-lowering and analysis are not separately observable through the production surface and are recorded as members of this interval, not imputed from it.
The same path to the SARIF surface. Against core-full-human it gives a renderer DIFFERENCE, which is not the same quantity as rendering in isolation and is never reported as if it were.

The launcher stopping after extraction (--emit-facts). No core runs, so this isolates the frontend stage of the user-visible path — #263's extraction phase, recorded and, per the brief, NOT a D7 gate.

The user-visible whole, through the production launcher with the engine explicitly selected. Each engine performs ITS OWN extraction: extraction is inside the elapsed time, because an end-to-end number that shares one extraction between engines is a core comparison wearing an end-to-end hat.

unobservable_phases.bridge-lowering: not separately observable through either engine's production surface; recorded as a member of the core-full-* interval.
unobservable_phases.analysis: same — isolating it would need production instrumentation, which #263-A is not authorized to add.

reproducibility.tolerance_source: the noise floor recorded by the earlier run, not a chosen number
